commits.message:
feat: gh-aw intake automation — PR review, triage, and digest workflows (phase 1)

Four agentic workflows (plus gh-aw's generated maintenance workflow) to
improve intake throughput; baseline to beat is time-to-first-review
P75 = 6.32 days.

- pr-reviewer: lane-aware, verdict-first first-pass review of same-repo
  PRs with routing labels
- backlog-sweeper: weekday sweep of the 8 oldest unreviewed PRs (forks
  included) with evidence-based recommend-close labels; never closes
- issue-triager: labels-only classification of new issues; never comments
- team-digest: weekday Discord digest of the PR/issue queue

All agents run read-only (strict: true); writes go through allowlisted
safe-outputs with per-run caps. Actions and containers are SHA-pinned.
Prompts tuned via a read-only dry-run simulation against the live queue.
commits.attribution_evidence: no supported agent signature in commit metadata

md_changes.file_patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+---
+name: Intake Digest
+description: Weekday-morning Discord digest of the PR/issue queue — merge-ready list, review queue by lane, SLA breaches, close queue, unanswered external issues
+on:
+  schedule: daily around 07:00 on weekdays
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+  issues: read
+  pull-requests: read
+engine:
+  id: claude
+network: defaults
+strict: true
+timeout-minutes: 10
+tools:
+  github:
+    toolsets: [default]
+safe-outputs:
+  jobs:
+    discord-digest:
+      description: Post the intake digest to the team Discord channel
+      runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+      output: Digest posted to Discord
+      inputs:
+        content:
+          description: The digest as Discord-flavored markdown (plain markdown, no HTML)
+          required: true
+          type: string
+      steps:
+        - name: Post to Discord
+          env:
+            WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_INTAKE_WEBHOOK_URL }}
+          run: |
+            set -euo pipefail
+            if [ ! -f "$GH_AW_AGENT_OUTPUT" ]; then
+              echo "No agent output found" && exit 1
+            fi
+            CONTENT=$(jq -r '.items[] | select(.type == "discord_digest") | .content' "$GH_AW_AGENT_OUTPUT")
+            if [ -z "$CONTENT" ]; then
+              echo "No digest content in agent output" && exit 1
+            fi
+            printf '%s' "$CONTENT" | split -C 1900 - /tmp/digest-chunk-
+            for chunk in /tmp/digest-chunk-*; do
+              PAYLOAD=$(jq -n --rawfile text "$chunk" '{content: $text, allowed_mentions: {parse: []}}')
+              curl -sf -X POST "$WEBHOOK_URL" \
+                -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+                -d "$PAYLOAD"
+              sleep 1
+            done
+  noop:
+  report-failure-as-issue: false
+pre-agent-steps:
+  - name: Pre-fetch open queue
+    env:
+      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+      REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
+    run: |
+      set -euo pipefail
+      mkdir -p /tmp/gh-aw/agent
+      gh pr list --repo "$REPO" --state open \
+        --json number,title,createdAt,updatedAt,isDraft,labels,author,reviewDecision \
+        --limit 200 > /tmp/gh-aw/agent/open-prs.json
+      gh issue list --repo "$REPO" --state open \
+        --json number,title,createdAt,labels,author,comments \
+        --limit 200 > /tmp/gh-aw/agent/open-issues.json
+---
+
+Compose the weekday intake digest for the ethereum.org team from the pre-fetched queue data in `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/open-prs.json` and `/tmp/gh-aw/agent/open-issues.json`, then post it with the `discord-digest` output. Today's date is in the run context.
+
+## Sections (omit any empty section entirely)
+
+1. **✅ Ready to merge** — open, non-draft PRs labeled or verdicted mergeable (look for `needs review 👀` with an approving review decision, or a first-pass review verdict of "Looks mergeable" in recent comments). One line each: `#123 title — author, age`.
+2. **👀 Needs review** — non-draft PRs awaiting a human, grouped by lane (content / translation / code / other), oldest first, max 3 per lane, with age in days. Note the count if truncated. If a PR already appears under SLA breaches, list it only there and note that in this section's header.
+3. **⚠️ SLA breaches** — PRs past the documented review SLA with no review decision: translations and high-priority bugs 4 days, typo fixes 8 days, minor content/features 14 days, major features/content/products 30 days. Judge the SLA class from labels and title; when unsure use 14 days.
+4. **🗑️ Recommend close** — PRs labeled `recommend close`, each with its number and the one-line reason from the sweeper's evidence if visible in labels/comments; otherwise just list them.
+5. **💬 Unanswered external issues** — open issues from non-team authors with zero comments, oldest first, max 5. The `comments` field in `open-issues.json` is an array of comment objects, not a count — "zero comments" means the array is empty.
+
+## Team authors
+
+Treat these handles as team (exclude from "external"): pettinarip, wackerow, myelinated-wackerow, nloureiro, konopkja, corwintines, minimalsm, nhsz, mnelsonBT, fredriksvantes, 0xMushow, 0xTylerHolmes, bshastry — plus any `[bot]` account. Keep this list in sync with the team; when an unlisted author dominates the section, flag it in the digest so a human can update the list.
+
+## Format rules
+
+- Discord markdown: `**bold**` section headers, `-` bullets, bare URLs like `<https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}/pull/123>` suppressed-embed style. No HTML, no tables.
+- Target under 3,500 characters total; prioritize Ready-to-merge and SLA breaches when trimming.
+- Start with a one-line summary: `**Intake digest — <N> open PRs, <M> open issues**`.
+
+## Termination
+
+If both queues are empty, call `noop` with a one-line reason instead of posting. Every run MUST end with a safe-output call.

commits.message:
fix(aw): stop Issue Triager re-processing the same issues forever

The scheduled Issue Triager fetched all `needs triage 📥` issues and, per
the old confidence rule, kept that label whenever an issue wasn't
"confidently actionable". Since that's usually a stable property (vague
bug reports, open proposals awaiting a team decision), those issues were
re-fetched and re-reasoned every 6h with no change — a wasteful loop that
ended in `noop`.

Make triage terminating: `needs triage 📥` now means only "not yet
triaged", and the agent always clears it after a pass, committing to a
best-guess type label even for vague issues. Spam/junk now gets a
terminal `invalid` label (instead of being parked in the queue), and the
digest gains a "Spam / invalid — to close" section so a human can clear
them. Duplicates are typed and cleared rather than kept in the queue.

The `invalid` label must exist in the repo (created separately).

commits.message:
fix(intake-digest): populate Ready-to-merge from comments + reviews

The digest pre-fetch only supplied reviewDecision, which is null for
nearly every PR on this repo (dev branch protection has
required_approving_review_count: 0), so the Ready-to-merge section was
always empty even though many PRs carry a first-pass 'Looks mergeable'
verdict comment.

Extend the single gh pr list call to also pull latestReviews + comments
inline, then derive approved / mergeableVerdict booleans with jq and drop
the heavy arrays before writing open-prs.json. PRs with an active
CHANGES_REQUESTED review are excluded so contested PRs don't show as
ready. Section 1 of the prompt now reads the pre-computed flags.

commits.message:
feat(intake-digest): link every PR/issue as a clickable Discord masked link

Bare #123 refs aren't clickable in Discord. Since the digest posts via
webhook (which supports masked links in message content), format every
reference as [#123](https://github.com/OWNER/pull|issues/123) so
maintainers can jump straight to the PR/issue. Masked links render inline
with no preview embed, so the old <>-wrapped bare-URL style is dropped.

structure and formatting between runs. Separate the concerns: terse
selection rules (what goes in each bucket) plus one literal output
template the agent fills in verbatim, with explicit rules for empty
sections, age format, lane truncation, and the 3,500-char trim order.
